book.name: Marqoosa Mishiraachcho
book.title: Marqoosi Xaafida Nu Godaa Yesus Kirstoosa Mishiraachcho Qaala

content: Yesusa Philaxoosakko Efida
Maalado wonttara qeeseta halaqati, dere cimatinne Muse wogaa tamaarsizayti kumeththa shango alaafetara issife zorettidi Yesusa qachchi ekki efidi Philaxoosas aaththi immida.
Philaxoosikka Yesusa, «Ne Ayhudata kawoo?» gi oychchides. Yesusikka, «Ee, ne gida mala» giidi izas zaarides.
Qeeseta halaqatikka daro yo7o iza bolla shiishshi mootida.
Philaxoosi qasse, «Ne aazas oyshaa zaarikkii? Hekko nena daro yo7on mooteettes» giidi qasseka oychchides.
Gido attiin Yesusi ha7ikka izas aykkoka zaaro immontta gishshas Philaxoosikka malalettides.
Paaziga ba7aale gallas Philaxoosi derey birshana mala oychchidaade birshi yeddiza wogay kase dees.
Iita ooson dere bolla dendidi shempo wodhida asatara issife qashettida Barbaane geetettiza issaadey dees.
Dereykka yiidi kase lose gididayssa izi ooththana mala Philaxoosa woossides.
Philaxoosikka isttas, «Ta inttes Ayhuda kawo birshana mala koyeetii?» gi oychchides.
Philaxoosi hessaththo oychchiday kase qeeseta halaqati Yesusa qanaaten aaththi immidayssa eriza gishshassa.
Qeeseta halaqati qasse, «Iza exa Barbaaney birshetto!» gi oychchana mala dereza denththeththida.
Philaxoosi, «Histtiko intte Ayhuda kawo giza addeza wosttana mala koyeetii?» gides.
Istti qasseka, «Kaqqa! Kaqqa!» gi waassida.
Philaxoosikka, «Ay iita ooththidee?» gi istta oychchides. Istti qasse, «Kaqqa! kaqqa!» giidi kaseppe aaththi waassida.
Philaxoosikka dereza ufayssana giidi Barbaane isttas birshides. Yesusa garafidi kaqqanaas aaththi immides.
Wottadarati Yesusa Bolla Qilccida
Wottadarati Yesusa dere haarizayssa gibbe ekki biidi attida wottadarata ubbaa shiishshida.
Yesusa zo7o may7o mayzida; agunththa akilile xaaxidi iza hu7en woththida.
Hessafekka, «Ayhuda kawo saroy nees gido!» gishe iza saroththida.
Iza hu7e guufera shocida; iza bollaka cuttida; gulbatidi izas goynnida.
Iza bolla qidhi kaa7idaappe guye kase mayzida zo7o may7oza qaari ekkidi kase iza may7oza zaari mayzidi kaqqanaaso ekki bida.
Yesusa Kaqeteth
Alakisandrosanne Erufoosa aawa Simoona geetettiza issi Qareena dere asi dereppe katama yizayssa Yesusa masqale wolqqara oykki toossida.
Hessafe guye Yesusa Golgota geetettizaso efida; izas birsheththay, «Asa hu7e guugge» guussa.
Karbbe geetettiza camora walakettida woyne cajje uyana mala izas immiin izi ekkontta ixxides.
Hessafe guye iza kaqqida; iza may7o issaade issaade awayssi gakkanaakko giidi saama yeggidi gishettida.
Istti iza kaqqishin wonttafe heedzdzu saate gidides.
Istti masqale bolla xaafi shiishshida mooto qaalay, «Ayhuda kawo» giza qaala.
Izara issife nam7u pangata issaa izappe ushachchara issaa hadirsara kaqqida.
Hessankka kase maxaafay, «Iitatara issife taybettides» gida tinbite qaalay polettides.
Ogera aadhdhi bizaytikka ba hu7e qaaththishe, «Oy! Oy! Xoossa Keeththaa laallada heedzdzu gallassan keexxanay nenee?» giidi iita cashshe cayishe,
«Ane ha7i masqale bollafe wodhdhada nena ashsha» gida.
Hessaththoka qeeseta halaqatinne Muse wogaa tamaarsizayti ba giddon issoy issaas, «Harata ashshides shin bana ashshana dandaybeenna» giidi iza qidhida.
«Nu iza be7idi ammanana mala ane hayssi Kirstoosi Isra7eeleta kawoy ha7i masqaleppe wodhdho» gida. Izara kaqettidaytikka iza bolla cashshe korida.
Yesusa Hayqo
Usuppun saateppe doommidi uddufun saate gakkanaas biittay wuri dhumides.
Uddufun saate bolla Yesusi, «Eelohe! Eelohe! Lama sabaqitane» giidi qaala dhoqqu histtidi waassides. Hessas birsheththay «Ta Xoossoo! Ta Xoossoo! Ne tana aazas aggadii?» guussa.
Heen eqqida asaappe issi issi asati hessa siyidi, «Eelaasa xeygeeskko!» gida.
Hessafe issi asi eleli biidi caalida woyne cajje
isponje mala miishshan gelththi kessidi miththa xeeran oyththidi uyana mala Yesusas shiishshides. Hessafe qasse, «Ane aggaagite; Eelaasi yiidi iza kaqoppe woththishin nu beyana» gides.
Hessafe Yesusi qaala dhoqqu histti waassidi shempo kezides.
Xoossa Keeththe magalashay hu7era duge nam7u kezi daakettides.
Yesusa ginara eqqida issi mato halaqay Yesusi hessaththo gita qaalara waassidi shempo kezishin be7idi, «Hayssaadey tumu Xoossa naakkoshin» gides.
He wode maccassati hanizayssa haahon diidi xeellida. Istta giddofe Magdaleppe yida Maaramanne kaalotiza Yaaqoobe Yoosa aayo Maaramira qasseka Saloomira issife deettes.
Heyti maccassati Galilan Yesusa kaallishenne izas ooththishe gam7idayta. Isttarakka issife hara daro maccassati Yerusalaame bida.
Gadey qammi qammi bishin Sambatas giigettiza gallassi gakkides.
Dere cimata giddon bonchchettida issi Armatiyase dere as Yooseefe geetettizayssi Xoossa Kawoteth naagishe dizaadey babbontta Philaxoosakko biidi Yesusa aha woossides.
Philaxoosikka izi hinni wode ellera hayqqidayssa siyidi malalettides. Mato halaqa xeygisidi, «Izi hayqqi gam7idee?» giidi oychchides.
Izi hayqqidayssa mato halaqay geeshshi eridaappe guye Yesusa aha Yooseefes immides.
Yooseefeykka moogo may7o shammidi ahaa masqaleppe woththidi moogo may7on xaaxidi shuchchafe woocettida duufon moogides. Duufaa doona shuchchara gordides.
Magdaleppe yida Maaramiranne Yooseefe aayo Maaramira Yesusa aha awan moogidaakko be7ida.

footnotes.text: Issi issi Geeshsha Maxaafati taybo 28 bolla diza qofaa gujjeettes; qaalazikka Luqaasan 22:37 bolla dizayssa misatees.
Caalida woyne cajje kaqettida asi ba waaye balana mala ushsheettes.
